title: 第9章 坏主意第10章 秀肌肉
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑拉开窗帘对张文喊道：“停车。”
马车停了下来，张文说道：“丞相怎么了？”
昔小苑看着张文示意的看了那一眼小孩，说道：“给那小男孩些干粮。”
“是。”张文拿出些干粮放在那小孩子手里。
小男孩看到张文走过去，小男孩强忍着害怕，接过张文手里的食物。
那小男孩眼里透着的喜悦，但是身子却有些颤抖，说道：“谢谢哥哥。”
张文揉了揉他的头说道：“不客气。”
小男孩被他这么一揉，小男孩害怕性的躲避。
小男孩有些害怕，但又有些礼貌的说道：“谢谢哥哥，我先走了，我奶奶已经在家等我了。”
张文微笑的点了点头说道：“去吧。”
小男孩立马拿着手里的干粮匆忙跑掉了。
张文看着那小男孩，觉得甚是奇怪，张文走了回去跟昔小苑说道：“丞相觉不觉得他们很奇怪，看着我们的眼神很是害怕。”
昔小苑淡定地说道：“看到了，干粮也给那些可怜人分分吧。”
昔小苑也觉得奇怪，为什么看到他们都是一脸害怕的样子呢？
俞月白看着昔小苑一脸崇拜的说道：“女神你好有爱心哦…”
沐梓丞在旁边躺着，一脸作呕的表情。
…………………分割线…………………
官府里。
“大人，丞相已经到城里了，要不要过去迎接。”
官府的头儿召簧看着手下一脸的着急，召簧一听反应过来有些愣住了，而后又一脸的微笑，不着急的说道：

“丞相不过一介女子罢了，能成什么气候，而且丞相她怕是忙着呢！可不会想到本官，下去吧~本官要休息了。”
客栈里。
昔小苑坐在二楼阳台上品着茶，小二把菜端过来的时候有些畏惧，昔小苑对小二说道：
“为何看到我们这么害怕？”
小二紧张的说道：“没…没…”然后就匆匆忙忙的走了。
有古怪！
昔小苑叫张文去查查到底怎么回事，而后思考着怎么对付土匪。
俞月白也觉得很奇怪，一路上的老百姓们都是投来异样害怕的眼光，进客栈的时候，小二们看到我们急忙想把门关上。
最后被我们把门抵住才进得来。
沐梓丞看着风景喝着茶，轻声缓缓说道：
“吾猜测，百姓这么怕我们，怕是有人做了些什么事导致他们那么害怕，而且有可能会是官员或者士兵……”
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan opened the curtains and shouted to Zhang Wen: "Stop the car."
The carriage stopped and Zhang Wen said, "What's wrong, Prime Minister?"
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at Zhang Wen and glanced at the child indicatingly, and said, "Give that little boy some dry food."
"Yes." Zhang Wen took out some dry food and put it in the child's hand.
The little boy saw Zhang Wen walking over. The little boy suppressed his fear and took the food from Zhang Wen's hand.
The little boy's eyes were filled with joy, but his body was trembling a little, and he said, "Thank you, brother."
Zhang Wen rubbed his head and said, "You're welcome."
The little boy was rubbed by him like this, and the little boy was afraid to avoid it.
The little boy was a little scared, but said politely: "Thank you, brother, I'll leave first. My grandma is already waiting for me at home."
Zhang Wen nodded with a smile and said: "Go."
The little boy immediately ran away with the dry food in his hand.
Zhang Wen looked at the little boy and felt it was very strange. Zhang Wen walked back and said to Xi Xiaoyuan: "Prime Minister, don't you think they are strange? They look at us with very scared eyes."
Xi Xiaoyuan said calmly: "You see, let's share the dry food with those poor people."
Xi Xiaoyuan also felt strange, why did they all look scared when they saw them?
Yu Yuebai looked at Xi Xiaoyuan with admiration and said: "Goddess, you are so caring..."
Mu Zicheng was lying next to him with a disgusted expression on his face.
………………Dividing line………………
In the government office.
"Sir, the Prime Minister has arrived in the city. Would you like to go over and greet him?"
The leader of the government, Zhao Huang, saw the anxious expressions on his men's faces. Zhao Huang was a little stunned when he heard the reaction, and then he smiled and said calmly:
"The Prime Minister is just a woman, how can she be like that? Besides, the Prime Minister is probably too busy! She won't think of me, so go down~ I need to take a rest."
In the inn.
Xi Xiaoyuan was sitting on the balcony on the second floor, sipping tea. When the waiter brought the dishes over, he was a little scared. Xi Xiaoyuan said to the waiter:
"Why are you so scared to see us?"
The waiter said nervously: "No...no..." and then left in a hurry.
Something weird!
Xi Xiaoyuan asked Zhang Wen to find out what was going on, and then thought about how to deal with the bandits.
Yu Yuebai also felt strange. The common people along the way looked at us with strange fear. When we entered the inn, the waiters saw us and hurriedly tried to close the door.
Finally we were able to get in after we blocked the door.
Mu Zicheng looked at the scenery and drank tea, and said softly and slowly:
"I guess that the people are so afraid of us because someone has done something to make them so afraid, and it may be officials or soldiers..."
